name: lemma-pair
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; TRACK_M_DISPOSABLE_PROFILE=1 bun research/track-m/install-cost-meter.ts /tmp/emission-originals >/tmp/emission-manifest; for mode in 0 1; do echo MODE=$mode; set +e; GDP_COUNT_LEMMA_CUTS=$mode TRACK_M_COST_PROFILE=1 timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/track-m/measure-focused-emission.ts replay-input/input.json; status=$?; set -e; echo EXIT=$status; [ $status -eq 0 ] || exit $status; done

name: inv1758-repeat
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; for run in 1 2 3; do echo RUN=$run; timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/track-m/verify-focused.ts replay-input/input.json Inv1758; done

name: proof-tests
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun test kernel core/count-recovery core/count-recovery-order.test.ts core/count-cases.test.ts core/count-focus-proof.test.ts core/count-cert-grow.test.ts core/count-witness.test.ts core/field-laws.test.ts core/lemma-cuts.test.ts research/protocols/ic3syn/mldr.test.ts

name: support-tests
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun test core/carry.test.ts core/scan-prefix.test.ts core/count-support.test.ts core/count-admission.test.ts core/counts-preflight.test.ts core/relevance.test.ts core/support-order.test.ts

name: check
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun run check
